sine.scope: Synthetic development, 64-node linearized tetrahedral block; known camera/geometry/mass; 2D tracks, not RGB inference

release.scope: Synthetic development, 64-node linearized tetrahedral block; known camera/geometry/mass; 2D tracks, not RGB inference

triangle.scope: Synthetic development, 64-node linearized tetrahedral block; known camera/geometry/mass; 2D tracks, not RGB inference

reverse.scope: Synthetic development, 64-node linearized tetrahedral block; known camera/geometry/mass; 2D tracks, not RGB inference

point_baseline.scope: Same training bank, 15000 steps, 256 batch, deterministic neural physical-parameter regressor

position_action.scope: 128 held-out worlds; unseen prescribed upward anchor motion after prefix; frozen models, no inverse fitting
position_action.command: 6 mm smooth upward displacement of inferred material attachment; applied external load released at .4s
position_action.known: Which inferred attachment receives the position command

cross_mesh.scope: 64 unseen parameter worlds; infer on 64 nodes from 125-node observations; force reversal; no retraining
cross_mesh.reference_limit: 125-node linear-elastic model, not a converged nonlinear physical ground truth

acquisition.scope: Approximate importance-weighted new-view diagnostic, not validated posterior update or active-poke policy
acquisition.selection: Gaussian logdet measurement covariance; no truth or future used in selection

calibration.scope: Trajectory predictive envelope calibrated on separate 125-node simulations; not zero-shot OOD calibration or physical-parameter coverage

rgb_prototype.scope: Synthetic RGB prefix with fixed known appearance/cameras, train-only 64D PCA; no real data

interpolation.scope: Eight withheld mid-interval frames in observed prefix; distinct from forecasting
interpolation.limitation: Fixed known appearance and camera; no claim of superiority over specialized video interpolation models

qualification.scope: Development diagnostics; test-derived, no model tuning from these results

local_observability.parameterization: six logit coordinates; linearized at inferred posterior means
local_observability.interpretation: Local sensitivity only; not global identifiability or calibrated posterior covariance
